posts.name: jeroen blokland
posts.text:
Hi @TruthGundlach,  

Here in the Netherlands, anyone with more than €30,000 in assets is considered wealthy.  

They get to pay a 36% tax on realized investment gains, including gains that just compensate for inflation. 

The government expects investors to keep track of every transaction themselves and report everything to the tax authorities.

And to keep things simple, our finance minister has proposed taxing directly held crypto and precious metals on unrealized gains instead. 

Give up direct ownership and buy an ETF-like product? You're back to being taxed on realized gains. 

Yes, the idea is to apply two tax systems to the same underlying asset.

All of this, of course, for the benefit of investors and a tax authority that has been struggling with overwhelming complexity and workloads for years.

Greetings from Rotterdam,  
Jeroen Blokland

posts.name: vitalik.eth
posts.text:
Ultimately, precompiles and EVM are both the wrong place to put most cryptography support into Ethereum. The reason is that precompiles and EVM both operate on data that has to be included into the ethereum chain somehow, which realistically means included in a block as calldata. That space is limited - even with PeerDAS and blocks-in-blobs, there's a practical cap of ~8 MB/s before it starts getting uncomfortable.

Remember: it's not a blockchain. It's a cryptographic world computer. Any data/computation that does not need to be in the "main thread" of data/execution should not be put into the main thread.

Instead, the correct solution is... EIP-8288 maximalism.

If you have any heavy computation that's self-contained, compute it and STARK it client-side (this is quickly getting faster and faster, even on phones), and push the STARK through the EIP-8288 recursive aggregation mechanism. The chain sees the fact that the computation was done and what the result is; it never needs to see the actual data and computation.

This way everyone can use whatever cryptography they want, the Ethereum chain can be lean, and we never need to add more precompiles again.

quoted.text:
> we could still ultimately do Lattice stuff for accounts, wallets, etc. through a precompile if it is proved to be AI-secure

The ideal route to support everyone's cryptography is imo through 8288. You make whatever signature you want locally, then STARK it, and then it gets included through the stark aggregator machine. Don't need any calldata onchain. Ethereum can then never add a new precompile again.

posts.name: 速溶猪 Yuxin
posts.text:
Token2049 期间，我受邀参加了火币的内部活动，做了一场 panel 分享，也出席了他们的 VIP 晚宴。另外和孙宇晨孙哥@justinsuntron 即兴约了一场采访，目前正在打磨问题。

**先替火币澄清一件事。晚宴原定 6 号，后来因为安排调整改到了 8 号。工作人员是真的尽心尽力，我亲眼看着他们为了协调好每一个人，焦灼地忙了全程。办过活动的人都知道，现场总有太多突发状况：场地临时变更，容纳人数跟着变，这些未知因素导致一些 VIP 没能到场。但团队自始至终都在积极解决问题。

火币的现场活动给我一种很不一样的感觉。在其他交易所的夹击之下，来到现场的反而都是火币多年的老用户，整场氛围其乐融融，非常家人向🙏感谢 @Ceee333_ 的邀请，她是这场活动的负责人之一，也是双语主持，业务能力相当过硬。还有@HTX_Molly @Lumibb_ @Xiaodu_HTX 等火币的小伙伴，每个人都很 energetic。这是我第一次深度接触火币的活动对接团队，评价很高（我不是托，是托死全家）。

**再说说我筹划的这场采访（目前身体太差的确稍微拖延了）。我有稍微看了下孙哥和邵艾伦那场”薄肌”采访，以及和自由潜冠军金明聊 Crypto、AI 与量子威胁的那场。我想问点不太一样的人文向问题，因为我的视角可能有些特别：我是从新概念时期就知道孙哥的。同为新概念作文大赛的获奖者，他某种程度上算是我的前辈。我第一次听到这个名字，是在《萌芽》上读到他写的《一道论证题》，所以对他的文青之路一路追踪非常熟稔。

我也注意到，孙哥提到他们生态里一直比较活跃的以太坊挖矿活动，所以也想专门问问他怎么看 ETH 这个资产。对于BTC被攻破这块，我和以太坊基金会做抗量子研究和在Yale/MIT读相关PHD的一些朋友交流过，他们对 Q-Day 的到来目前还算比较乐观，这个话题也想和他聊聊。

**最后一个小提议：**除了数学奖，火币很值得再设一个文学奖/人文奖。我感觉现在这些交易所办的这种访谈活动，基本上都是跟交易员对谈，来来回回，其实也都是那些交易员，同质化程度太高了，包括打广告的 KOL 也是，基本上是今天做完交易所 A 的广告，明天又去发交易所 B 的广告。孙哥既是新概念出身，又做过社交 App（陪我），某种程度上“薄肌”也算是一种文化输出了，那是否火币可以系统性以活动的形式支持更多元的加密文化输出？

先发散到这儿，抛砖引玉，之后再细聊。
